title: Fair Turn
user: Adults sharing a home who need recurring chores to rotate fairly, account for absences, and make swaps explicit without gamifying or surveilling each other.
smallest_useful_product: An offline household PWA that defines chores, cadence, eligible people, vacation dates, equitable rotation, and a QR-shareable current board.
constraints: Local-first sharing with explicit export/import; no collection of relationship data; deletions and neutral language.
